original_target.title: Global null control of a heat equation with cubic growth

scope_comparison: The published LeBalc'h–Takahashi Theorem1.1 assumes small initial data as equation1.7. Its scalar odd-growth global question is separate from global cascade control using cubic couplings. Neither absorbing reaction nor small-data local control proves arbitrary-data, arbitrary-time null control with growing+y3.
